title: Demand-Side Effects of Open Innovation: The Case of Cryptocurrency Forking
eligible_reason: Treatment is not a binary adoption indicator. The regressor of interest, Event_bef6Month, is the number of forks launched in the preceding six months (a count), split by parent type (platform/transaction) and popularity (Event_bef6Month_plat, Event_bef6Month_nonpop, Event_bef6Month_nonpop_plat), and it is instrumented (ivreg2 with lagged similarity instruments L4.Sim_*). Every regression also includes time-varying controls (lnfinal_tradevolume_m, Missing_Trdin, lnpriceusd, D.lnpriceusd, Roi30d). Fails the binary-treatment, no-IV and no-time-varying-controls rules.
design_notes: Coin-by-month panel (tsset encodedcoin groupmonth) of 42 parent cryptocurrencies, 2011-2021. Outcomes: lnTxCnt (log transactions), lnusers, lnolduser, lnnew, lnmonthdev, lnnewdev, lnMonthcount. Fixed effects i.encodedcoin (coin) and i.year (year, not month) partialled out; two-way clustering by groupmonth and encodedcoin via vcemway. Table 4 reports first stages (reg of fork counts on L4.Sim_* instruments); Tables 5-10 and Figures 2-3 are second-stage IV regressions. Figure 1 is a descriptive plot of mean lnTxCnt_Std by Treated and Time_to_fork. No DiD-with-adoption-dates specification exists in the code.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Not applicable: treatment is a rolling count of forks, not an adoption date. Fork launches span 2011-2021.

specs.treatment_var: Event_bef6Month Event_bef6Month_plat Event_bef6Month_nonpop Event_bef6Month_nonpop_plat (instrumented by L4.Sim_tx L4.Sim_plat L4.Sim_NonPop_plat L4.Sim_NonPop_tx)
specs.treatment_definition: Number of forks of the parent coin launched before the last 6 months (24 weeks), interacted with platform and non-popular indicators
specs.data_file: not shipped (no use statement; 'Load Data' placeholders)
specs.notes: Representative of all second-stage regressions in Tables 5-10 and Figures 2-3.

specs.exclusion_reason: first-stage regression of fork count on instruments; not a DiD

data_files_note: README (ReadMe.docx) states the package does not include the dataset under an agreement with the Department Editor; data must be rebuilt from Coinmetrics, CoinMarketCap, Tokenview, Yahoo Finance, CryptoQuant, GitHub and blockchain explorers. Package contains only Code_Share.do (186 lines, no file paths) and MS_Sub.smcl (log).
software_notes: Stata: vcemway, ivreg2, reg, coefplot, eststo. The regression-extraction file data/packages/mnsc.2021.03132_regressions.txt is empty, apparently because the do-file was not parsed; commands were read directly from Code_Share.do.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Full-text flags (ft_staggered, ft_goodman_bacon, cite_goodman_bacon_2021) likely reflect discussion rather than an estimated staggered binary DiD; nothing in the shipped code estimates one.
